ob.title: Konsil desid dat pro kombat kontr Drakon
ob.content:
Durantu sue prim sesion sidiurne, Konsil Komtian de Hellcraft votav in desision 6:0:2 ke kombat kontr Ender-Drakon aksidero u in saturndi, 28im yuni, u po ke konstruasioni de kastel Bloodspire es kompletifiked, omni kekos es plu tard. Setre, Konsil votav 5:3 transdonar Drakon-ov a Ari po kombat tale ke ila potes kuvar it, plase ke it es meted in musé. Plasu elkos, musé poteserio presentar fotografad in kualitet bas de ov in dom de Ari.

Po debat prolonged e ke on proposav opsioni multupl, Konsil desidav adiurnar vot definitiv de kel sistem de adres deberio esar adopted ofisiale usk ke idé es rafined sufise e on av atined konsens. Tem de kel lingu konstrued deberio adopted es et adiurned.

Not per redaktor (9im yuli 2026): Ist artikl originale nomav Ari ko sie nom ansian. Ist error av esed fiksed.

en.title: Council decides date for Dragon fight
en.content:
During its first session today, the Hellcraft County Council voted in a 6:0:2 decision that the fight against the Ender Dragon will happen either on Saturday, June 28, or after constructions on Castle Bloodspire are complete, whichever is later. Furthermore, the Council voted 5:3 to transfer the Dragon Egg to Ari after the fight so she can hatch it, instead of putting it in a museum. Instead, the museum could showcase a low quality photo of the egg in Ari's house.

After a prolonged debate and multiple options being proposed, the Council decided to postpone a definitive vote on which addressing system to adopt officially until the idea has been sufficiently workshopped and a consensus reached. The topic of which conlang to adopt was also postponed.

Editor's note (9 July 2026): This article originally referred to Ari by her old name. This error has been fixed.
